Name: Stop Offering My Stuff
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
[size=4]Stop Offering My Stuff!
[/size]
[size=3]Allows you to temporarily (or permanently) disable the "Offer your [item] to [player]?" popups that can sometimes get in the way in multiplayer.[/size][size=3] This mod supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], so it is recommended that you install that mod as well to easily change the keybind settings.

Source available on [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/StopOfferingMyStuff]GitHub[/url].[/size]
